# Reach Social Case Studies

> Operator playbooks from Reach Social — real TikTok Shop wins, framework-named and anonymized where required.

## Case studies

- [$500 In, $3,500 Out. 600% ROI, and the Campaign Was Only Half Done.](https://reachsocial.co/casestudies/negotiated-retainer-flip-health-wellness/): 600% ROI ($500 spent, $3,500 GMV) at the halfway point of the campaign
- [GMV 3.3× in One Month. Affiliates Drove 82% of It.](https://reachsocial.co/casestudies/affiliate-reactivation-system-personal-care/): TikTok Shop GMV $121.7K (June), affiliate GMV $99.9K (82% of shop, up 3.2x), 2,066 active subscriptions (up 2.6x)
- [Zero Lives Ever Run. $600+ in Live GMV in Two Weeks.](https://reachsocial.co/casestudies/outside-host-live-launch-health/): Live GMV $600+ total, $170+/hr Live GMV
- [Six Figures in 26 Days. One Milestone Month on TikTok Shop.](https://reachsocial.co/casestudies/gmv-milestone-stack-food-bev/): $100K GMV in 26 days
- [GMV Max Doubled in One Promo Week. And ROI Went Up With It.](https://reachsocial.co/casestudies/peak-demand-gmv-scale-oral-care/): GMV Max $4,566 in the promo week (+111% WoW), ROI 1.98, then sustained scale into June
- [GMV Up 150% in One Month. Product Selection Did the Work.](https://reachsocial.co/casestudies/licensed-ip-test-hobbies-toys/): Roughly $1,500+/month on the account (this month), 150% growth month over month
- [A $70K Goal Hit $79K. Through a Constant Stream of Platform Violations.](https://reachsocial.co/casestudies/violation-resilient-gmv-growth-pet-supplies/): $79k GMV for May, beating goal by $9k despite ongoing platform violations
- [A $30K Monthly Goal, Cleared 10 Days Early. $33K and the Month Wasn't Over.](https://reachsocial.co/casestudies/seeding-stack-beat-health-wellness-supplements/): $33k GMV reached by May 21, 10 days before month end
- [Two Flat Months, Then the Highest GMV Yet. Without Spending More.](https://reachsocial.co/casestudies/affiliate-sampling-refinement-baby-maternity/): June GMV $150K+ (highest yet, month still in progress at time of report)
- [AOV Up 11.52% in a Month. Without Leaning on Item Discounts.](https://reachsocial.co/casestudies/bundle-aov-lift-wellness-supplements/): July AOV $40.07 (+11.52% MoM)
- [Daily Ad Budget +125%. $10K GMV in Four Days of June.](https://reachsocial.co/casestudies/controlled-ad-scale-food-bev/): Daily ad budget $1,125/day after ~10-day controlled scale; $10K+ GMV in first 4 days of June
- [Three Weeks of Dead GMV Max Ads, Fixed in One Reset. +112% the Next Week.](https://reachsocial.co/casestudies/gmv-max-reconnect-fix-food-beverage/): GMV Max issue resolved; 112% increase in GMV WoW
- [A 22-Day High in the Off-Season. $824 When We Expected $300.](https://reachsocial.co/casestudies/slow-season-gmv-high-pest-control/): $824 daily GMV, a 22-day high
- [A Client-Requested Test Failed. The Month Still Closed at $161K.](https://reachsocial.co/casestudies/gmv-recovery-reallocation-food-bev/): +45% GMV MoM, $111K to $161K
